div.div:
Recovery limits
- SQL CDC retention must still contain the committed LSN.
- Losing connect-offsets or schema history is a different recovery incident.
- SQL Server schema changes are unsupported during an incremental snapshot.
- Normal resume is documented design, not yet container-proven by #68.
